title: People First
tagline: Our misión is to harness the transformative potential of blockchain technology to create a positive and lasting impact on the lives of vulnerable communities in Africa and Peru
description: Our mision is to harness the transformative potential of blockchain technology to create a positive and lasting impact on the lives of vulnerable communities in Africa and Peru. We believe in a world where everyone has access to essential resources and enjoys the right to a healthy and dignified life.
how_its_made:
Explore Initiatives: Discover UNICEF projects addressing water scarcity in Africa and combating Dengue in Peru.

Choose Your Cause: Select a cause that resonates with you—empower communities through targeted contributions.

Contribute Securely: Use Scroll and World Coin to securely make your impact, ensuring transparency and traceability.

Track Progress: Monitor the real-world impact of your contribution, from milestones achieved to positive changes in communities.

Join the Community: Connect with like-minded individuals, share experiences, and amplify the impact of Scroll for Change.

Spread the Word: Share your story and encourage others to join the movement. Together, we make waves of impact.
